title: Vishnu Dharmam - 06 - Yudhishthira Chandala Samwaadam
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: In our previous entry, we saw the concept of Now we will see a short story that summarizes everything we have seen so far. Yudhishthira was a very fair, just ruler of Indraprastha. To test his sense of dharma, Yamadarma is said to have taken the form of a (beggar) and visited Yudhishthira at the royal palace. It was customary at the time not to allow beggars into the palace.
